   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  JUNE 9, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. Responding to roll call were Chair Leon, Vice Chair
Ang, Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of
Communications and Public Affairs and Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Ang made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes for
May 12, 2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Commissioner Appreciation Dinner

Mrs. Ocegueda confirmed that all Commissioners will attend the event. Mrs. Ocegueda asked
Commissioners to be at the Sproul Room no later than 4:45 p.m. to discuss duties and event
coordination.

Business Spotlight

Mrs. Ocegueda showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the May Threading/Waxing Spots edition
video to Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda informed the Commission that votes were still being taken
for the June Donuts edition and will be going out later in the week to film once results were obtained.

New Social Media Series

Mrs. Ocegueda reported that she has met with Communications and Multi-Media staff to go over the
outline Vice Chair Ang provided and discussed how to move this project forward. Mrs. Ocegueda
informed the Commissioners that based on that meeting, the first possible video for this series would
not be ready until January 2026. Until then staff will continue to meet to pick a series name, series
topics and create a logo to present to the Commission in the next few months for their feedback and
approval.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda provided Commissioners with a flyer that confirmed dates of the Independence Day
Festival, the Summer Concerts and the Front Street Fridays to continue their efforts with their
merchandise survey. Chair Leon confirmed she will be available for the July 9th, July 23rd Summer
Concerts and the July 18th Front Street Friday. Vice Chair Ang confirmed he’s available only for the
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
June 9, 2025

July 9th Summer Concert and possibly available for the Independence Day Festival. Commissioner
Garcia confirmed he will be available for the Independence Day Festival, August 1st, August 15th Front
Street Fridays and the August 6th Summer Concert. Commissioner Sanchez will get back to staff
regarding his availability.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez stated that the Memorial Day Ceremony at its new location went well, and he
was also excited to have participated in the 2nd Annual 5K Run. Chair Leon commented she also
enjoyed participating in the 5K Run and she attended the Cerritos College Native Plant Sanctuary event
that was mentioned by the professors during the last meetings native plant presentation.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 6:43 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
